scope: Read-only source integration review of the AP save snapshot/journal plumbing and actual Return to Spawn/native game lifecycle. No new native build, runtime gameplay session, network calls, or mirrored tests were performed.

checks.finding: SaveSection copies SaveContext, then captures all AP persistence fields on the game thread. SaveFileThreaded receives ArchipelagoSaveSnapshot by value. Its thread-local const pointer refers to that job-owned parameter during section serialization and is cleared before return. The journal and identity are read from the same captured value, not the live Client.

checks.finding: LoadRandomizer reads the exact saved journal field and seed/team/slot values, calls LoadSaveMetadata with that identity, then calls LoadRevealedHintTargetsJson. The Client validates every target against the restored identity before changing the journal.

checks.finding: The loader defaults an absent old-save journal field to an empty string. Nonthrowing JSON parsing returns a non-array, and the Client returns false before modifying the map. This safely yields no restored entries for a fresh load and leaves newer in-memory entries intact on a same-identity reload. Oversized or malformed arrays are rejected before merge. Native readHints keys are not replayed as proof of fully displayed text.

LoadSaveMetadata preserves revealedHintTargets whenever both old and loaded saves are AP saves with the same valid seed/team/slot, independently of network/worker health. The journal loader merges the saved map into the live map; it does not replace or clear newer completed hint targets.

checks.finding: Worker reuse requires the same valid save/live seed/team/slot, address, slot name, cached/live settings, authentication, and running worker. That branch requests refreshed snapshots without ResetFinderMirror. ReconcileSaveConnection only rebinds/reset when the address or identity requires it; normal same-save reload does not change wasAuthenticated. Real reconnects, title-screen visits, changed identities/settings, or a failed worker intentionally retain reset behavior.

BeginSaveMenuReload synchronously calls Sram_OpenSave -> Save_LoadFile -> LoadFile -> LoadRandomizer, without a Client reset in the Context/InitFile reset path. BetterSaveMenu then emits exit/load hooks and selects Play_Init. The exit hook waits for save jobs; the randomizer lifecycle hooks reset entrance/recovery state and do not reset the AP journal/worker. The Client is registered only at startup, not on IS_RANDO. GameState_Update invokes AP frame hooks while the current PlayState exists. RunFrame destroys the old PlayState and initializes the next PlayState before its next GameState_Update, so no AP update observes the brief null gPlayState between Play_Destroy and Play_Init.

checks.finding: The actual Sram_InitSave -> Archipelago_InitSaveFile -> PrimeNewSaveMetadata creation path now resets completed-hint history before the first CaptureSaveSnapshot, preventing mixed-identity journal serialization. The fix is restricted to creation; Return to Spawn retains same-save newer hints and the managed worker lifetime.

findings.impact: Creating an AP file for another seed/slot in the same process can persist journal targets from the prior identity. The all-or-nothing journal loader later rejects that mixed array, losing restored valid new hints.
findings.reason: PrimeNewSaveMetadata changes the save identity without clearing revealedHintTargets. Enable/Disable and native InitFile retain the journal. GetRevealedHintTargetsJson serializes every retained row.
findings.requested_resolution: Clear journal under hintJournalMutex when priming a genuinely new file, refresh the merged hint list/publication timer, and add a production-fragment test for the actual PrimeNewSaveMetadata method. Preserve same-save merge/reuse behavior.
findings.resolution: PrimeNewSaveMetadata now clears revealedHintTargets under hintJournalMutex at genuine new-file creation, resets nextHintPublish, and rebuilds hints after stamping the new identity. Same-save LoadSaveMetadata preservation and LoadRevealedHintTargetsJson merge are unchanged.
findings.regression: The actual extracted production PrimeNewSaveMetadata method is compiled in the reveal harness. Its new-file case tests both same-room and different seed/team/slot creation, then serializes/restores only a newly revealed target.
